metadata.description: OMP edition, generated from .claude-plugin/marketplace.json by scripts/build_omp_edition.py

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Perform comprehensive code review for security, performance, and architecture. Save reviews to file, fix issues via /fix-report (paginated) or /fix-all (bulk, then offers to resolve needs-decision findings, optional severity floor). Persist PR review feedback via /analyze-feedback. Optional verification phase for cross-analysis and adversarial review. Composite findings group symptoms with one cause and are fixed as one unit.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Generate meaningful commit messages and block force-push while guarding pushes to protected branches

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: Delivers approved plan-mode plans: each task goes to the developer agent that owns its files, is reviewed and committed, then the plan's verification and the full code review run. Oh My Pi only.

plugins.name: frontend-developer
plugins.description: Enforces TypeScript + React best practices, coding standards, TDD workflow, and modern tooling (Tailwind, Zustand, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, TanStack Router)

plugins.name: php-developer
plugins.description: Enforces PHP best practices, coding standards, TDD workflow, and modern tooling for Symfony, Doctrine ORM, and DDD projects

plugins.name: plan-review
plugins.description: Reviews every plan-mode plan with the advisor-role model before it reaches the approval dialog: xd://propose stays blocked until the review approves the plan or 3 review rounds are used. Oh My Pi only.

plugins.name: python-developer
plugins.description: Master the Python programming language for efficient and effective development
